messages.subject: Instruction - Martin Hale exit
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sarah,

Following our call yesterday, I'd like to formally instruct Whitfield Carter to advise Wexford on the exit of Martin Hale, our COO. As you know he raised a formal grievance on 12 September and we are concerned he may bring a tribunal claim. Edward (cc'd) has approved engaging you on this.

We'd like to reach a negotiated settlement if possible. Could you let us know next steps and your team?

Many thanks,
Karen Mensah
HR Director, Wexford Holdings Limited

messages.subject: RE: Instruction - Martin Hale exit
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Karen,

Thank you - we're glad to assist. Tom Gallagher (cc'd) will lead the day-to-day conduct and I'll supervise. Our first step is to assess the merits of the unfair dismissal and any discrimination exposure, then make a without prejudice approach to Mr Hale's advisers. Could you send us the grievance letter, his service agreement and the recent reorganisation papers?

We'll circulate a short advice note this week.

Best regards,
Sarah Whitfield
Partner

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
